title: Kristang language
description: Creole language spoken in Malaysia and Singapore
extract: Papia Kristang also known as Malaccan (Creole) Portuguese, or simply as Kristang, is a creole language spoken by the Kristang, a community of people of mixed Portuguese and indigenous Malay ancestry, chiefly in Malaysia (Malacca), Singapore and Perth, Western Australia.
